name: manual_644ba4
claim: Keep using PT .agent memory for significant work, but do not record the owner's literal Gmail address in memory files; use a neutral owner-identity label while keeping allowlists and attribution tooling authoritative elsewhere.

decisions.notes: The owner clarified that memory capture must continue; only the literal Gmail address is prohibited inside .agent/memory so portable memory does not preserve personal contact details.
